title: Power Pages: performance and usage metrics in the Power Platform admin center monitor hub
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented admin paths and general Monitor requirements are supported, and targeted searches confirmed the Power Pages-specific documentation gaps. One minor correction should acknowledge that Microsoft's prerelease export documentation describes 30-day metric retention, whereas the cited Monitor overview states 28 days.

claims.claim: No Learn page describing this Power Pages monitor hub capability was found.

claims.claim: General Monitor documentation states that metrics are available for up to 28 days.

claims.fix: After the retention sentence, add: "Microsoft's prerelease Monitor metrics export documentation instead states that Monitor retains daily metric aggregates for 30 days (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/monitoring/monitor-data-export)." Keep the existing attribution of 28 days to the Monitor overview.

claims.claim: Power Pages-specific differences from the general Monitor retention periods are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "Monitor" "retention". Opened Monitor overview and metrics export; the latter gives a general 30-day window but no Power Pages-specific retention rule or supported product identifier.

claims.claim: Paid export options for this integration are not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "monitor" "paid export"; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/monitoring "licensing" "export". Opened Monitor metrics export and licensing FAQ; no paid Power Pages Monitor export option is stated.

claims.claim: Site diagnostic logging is reached in Power Platform admin center through Resources > Power Pages sites > site > Site Actions > Enable diagnostics logs.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and api; controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: No Power Pages-specific enablement or scoping switch in Monitor is documented on the UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "Monitor" "scoping"; "Power Platform API" "Power Pages" "Monitor" "enable". Opened Monitor overview, tenant-level analytics, Websites API, pac pages and pac admin; no integration-specific switch is documented.

claims.claim: Monitor generally requires tenant-level analytics to be enabled.
claims.quote: Tenant-level analytics must be turned on to make data available for Monitor experiences.

claims.claim: The general enablement path is Power Platform admin center > Manage > Tenant settings > Analytics > Tenant-level analytics > Enable > Save.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Tenant settings. On the Tenant settings page, select Analytics. In the Analytics pane, turn the Tenant-level analytics option to Enable. Select Save.

claims.claim: The Monitor area provides a reporting experience for admins and makers, with health metrics aggregated from runtime event logs.
claims.quote: The Monitor experience is available to both makers ... and admins ... Metrics are calculated by aggregating daily event logs from runtime activity; they're not real-time.

claims.claim: Capacity management provides Power Pages capacity consumption and licensing views.
claims.quote: The Power Pages capacity management experience in the Power Platform admin center allows administrators to manage Power Pages capacity and monitor capacity consumption. This experience also provides an overview of the different licensing models in use.

claims.claim: The default state of the Power Pages monitor hub integration is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Pages" "monitor" "default"; "Power Platform API" "Power Pages" "Monitor" "enable". Re-read roadmap description; opened Monitor overview and tenant-level analytics. No source states the integration's arrival default.
